title: Fruit Smoothie Juice Drink with Dairy

content.title: About
content.content: Fruit smoothie juice drink with dairy is a ready‑to‑drink beverage that blends fruit purees, juices, and dairy components. It combines the sweetness of ripe fruits with a creamy milk texture, delivering a pleasant taste and nutritional value.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Smoothies are often made from several fruit varieties, boosting their vitamin profile.
Adding dairy makes the drink richer in protein and calcium compared with pure fruit juices.
The beverage is conveniently packaged in a sealed bottle that stays fresh for up to 24 hours without refrigeration.
Some versions contain a small amount of added sugar for flavor balance, but sugar‑free options are also available.
In many countries these drinks are sold as “ready‑to‑drink” (RTD) and are subject to specific food regulations.

items.title: Rich in vitamins C and A
items.content: The fruit component supplies vitamin C for immune support and vitamin A for eye and skin health.

items.title: Source of calcium and protein
items.content: Dairy provides calcium for bones and protein that aids tissue repair.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: Water from the juices and milk helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Fruit polyphenols and vitamin E from dairy act as antioxidants, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Simple sugars from fruit combined with dairy protein give a quick and sustained energy source.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who cannot digest lactose may experience bloating, gas, or diarrhea.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to milk proteins (casein, whey) can have allergic reactions.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Some versions contain added sugar, which is undesirable for diabetics or those watching weight.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Acidic fruit juices may aggravate heartburn in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Consume the drink chilled straight from the bottle after opening. It can be used as a base for cocktails, added to dessert sauces, or enjoyed as a refreshing snack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, finish within 24 hours. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
